features.name: Sales Line Suggestion with Copilot
features.description: An AI-powered feature that helps users create sales documents by suggesting sales lines based on natural language input. Users can either list items with quantities or refer to existing documents to copy lines from.
caveats: Only available in English language variants (Australian, New Zealand, British English)
Not available in Canada due to legal requirement for bilingual release
Works only with item type lines, not general ledger, resources or comment lines
Only populates item number and quantity fields
Cannot combine product search and document search in same prompt
Cannot use relative criteria like best selling or most sold
Results depend heavily on quality of product data and descriptions

features.name: Prompt Guides for Sales Line Suggestion
features.description: Built-in starting points to assist users in formulating their prompts, such as copy from existing order number or copy from last invoice for document lookup, and add items with quantities for item listing.

features.name: Document Search via Partial Reference
features.description: Ability to search for existing documents using partial document numbers, external reference numbers, or other reference fields to copy lines from in sales line suggestions.
caveats: Searches only existing sales quotes, orders, posted shipments and posted invoices

features.name: Item Search via Attributes and Catalog
features.description: Intelligent search mechanism that looks across item descriptions, names, categories, attributes, translations, variants, and extended text lines to match user requests for items in sales line suggestions.
caveats: Does not search marketing text or attachments
Quality depends on how product data is maintained

features.name: Search Confidence Reporting
features.description: Extra information provided with sales line suggestions showing how well the copilot results match the initial prompt, helping users review and validate AI-generated suggestions.

features.name: Matching Criteria Selection
features.description: Options for users to specify search precision level when looking for items: permissive, balance, or precise mode to control how strictly keywords must match.

features.name: Email Content Parsing for Sales Lines
features.description: Ability to copy and paste email content directly into the prompt, and copilot intelligently identifies user intent, distinguishes items being praised versus items to purchase, and extracts relevant items.

features.name: Sales Line Suggestion Action
features.description: New action available on sales order, sales quote, and sales invoice documents that opens a prompt dialog for entering natural language requests to generate suggested sales lines.
